title: 第290章 不差不差第289章 斩龙一刀
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
刀光斩落，结结实实地劈在了龙君的胸膛之上。
那一刹那，刀罡四射，银白色的刀芒如同炸开的星辰，向四面八方迸溅开来，将广场四周的空气切割得支离破碎。
狂暴的气浪以龙君为中心向外席卷，脚下的青石板寸寸龟裂，碎石被气浪卷起，在半空中被残余的刀意绞成齑粉。
龙君的身体在刀光中向后滑退，双脚在地面上犁出两道深深的沟壑，直退出数十米远，才堪堪稳住身形。
他胸前的衣袍被刀气撕裂了一道口子，衣襟微微散乱，几缕发丝也被刀风吹得凌乱不堪。
然而，仅此而已。
那道足以开山裂石的惊天刀气，劈在他的胸膛之上，竟留下一道微不可察的刀痕。
“这……”
围观的众人看着被劈飞数十米、衣裳略显凌乱的龙君，却没有一个人的脸上浮现出笑意。
相反，所有人的心头都泛起了一股寒意。
能够来到这里的，皆是实力强悍之辈，完全能够感受到顾铮那一刀的可怖。
那一刀的力量，足以将一座小山丘夷为平地，足以将一名混元境的高手拦腰斩断。
然而，这头老蛟龙，竟然以完全不设防的姿态，硬生生用肉身接下了这一刀，仅仅只是衣裳凌乱了一些。
这是何等可怖的体魄？！
“这老泥鳅……”敖言溪的心头微微一沉。
她身为龙族，自然知道龙种的体魄远超寻常生灵，但这头老蛟龙的肉身强度，还是超出了她的预估。
它虽然尚未化龙，但距离真龙已然相差无几，其体魄之强横，恐怕比她想象的还要可怕。
她不由得为顾铮捏了一把冷汗。
龙君低下头，看了看自己胸前那道被刀气撕裂的衣口，伸手轻轻摸了摸那轻微的伤痕，仿佛在感受那一刀的余韵。
他吐出一口浊气，抬起头来，望向顾铮，脸上的笑意稍稍收敛了几分，但那双眼睛却比之前更亮了，亮得如同两团燃烧的火焰。

“不差，不差！”他朗声说道，声音中带着一股见猎心喜的兴奋，“继续！继续！！！”
一击不中，顾铮没有丝毫的迟疑与胆怯。他的眼神甚至比出刀之前更加沉静，仿佛刚才那一刀不过是热身而已。
他深吸一口气，第二步踏出，第二刀已然出手！
这一刀与第一刀截然不同。
不再是那种一往无前的劈斩，而是以一种刁钻至极的角度斜撩而上，刀锋划出一道诡异的弧线，仿佛一条银色的毒蛇从地面窜起，直噬龙君的咽喉！
刀速比第一刀快了近一倍，空气被刀锋撕裂时发出的不再是爆鸣声，而是一种尖锐到近乎刺耳的啸音，如同鬼哭神嚎！
铛！！！
刀锋斩在龙君的脖颈上，发出一声如同敲击洪钟般的巨响。火花四溅，龙君的脖子上连一道白痕都没有留下，但他的身体却被这一刀蕴含的巨力震得微微向一侧倾斜了半步。
龙君的眉毛微微挑了一下，眼中闪过一丝意外。
不是因为这一刀伤到了他，而是因为这一刀的角度和速度，让他产生了一种“若是不防，或许真的会被伤到”的错觉。
顾铮没有停顿。
第三刀紧随而至！
content_en:
The sword slashed down and hit Long Jun's chest firmly.
At that moment, the sword was fired in all directions, and the silver-white sword light was like an exploding star, splashing out in all directions, cutting the air around the square into pieces.
The violent air waves swept outward with Long Jun as the center. The bluestone slab under his feet was cracked inch by inch. The gravel was picked up by the air waves and twisted into powder by the remaining sword intent in mid-air.
Long Jun's body slid back in the light of the sword, and his feet plowed two deep ravines on the ground. He retreated dozens of meters away before he could stabilize his body.
The robe on his chest was torn apart by the sword's wind, and the skirt of his clothes was slightly scattered, and a few strands of hair were also messed up by the sword's wind.
However, that's all.
The shocking sword energy, which was capable of splitting mountains and rocks, struck his chest, leaving an imperceptible knife mark.
"This..."
The onlookers looked at Long Jun, who was sent flying dozens of meters and whose clothes were a little messy, but no one had a smile on their face.
On the contrary, everyone felt a chill in their hearts.
Those who can come here are all powerful people, and they can fully feel the terror of Gu Zheng's sword.
The power of that sword was enough to level a small hill to the ground, and it was enough to cut off a Hunyuan realm master in half.
However, this old dragon actually took the knife with his body in a completely defenseless manner, but his clothes were just a little messy.
What a terrifying physique is this? !
"This old loach..." Ao Yanxi's heart sank slightly.
As a dragon, she naturally knew that the physical strength of dragons was far superior to that of ordinary creatures, but the physical strength of this old dragon still exceeded her expectations.
Although it has not yet transformed into a dragon, it is already very close to a real dragon, and its physical strength may be even more terrifying than she imagined.
She couldn't help but break into a cold sweat for Gu Zheng.
Long Jun lowered his head and looked at the garment opening on his chest that was torn by the sword's energy. He stretched out his hand and gently touched the slight scar, as if feeling the aftertaste of the sword.
He exhaled a breath, raised his head, and looked at Gu Zheng. The smile on his face faded slightly, but his eyes were brighter than before, as bright as two burning flames.
"Not bad, not bad!" He said loudly, with a hint of excitement in his voice, "Continue! Continue!!!"
Gu Zheng didn't show the slightest hesitation or timidity after missing a single hit. His eyes were even calmer than before the knife was drawn, as if the knife just now was just a warm-up.
He took a deep breath, took the second step, and the second knife was already shot!
This knife is completely different from the first knife.
It is no longer the kind of indomitable slash, but it is tilted upward at an extremely tricky angle. The blade draws a strange arc, like a silver poisonous snake rising from the ground and biting the Dragon Lord's throat!
The speed of the knife was nearly twice as fast as that of the first knife. When the air was torn by the blade, the sound was no longer a crackling sound, but a sharp and almost harsh howling sound, like the howling of a ghost!
clang! ! !
The blade struck Long Jun's neck, making a loud sound like the striking of a bell. Sparks flew everywhere, and not even a white mark was left on Long Jun's neck, but his body was slightly tilted half a step to one side by the huge force contained in the knife.
Long Jun raised his eyebrows slightly, and a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
It was not because the knife hurt him, but because the angle and speed of the knife gave him the illusion that "if he didn't guard against it, he might really be hurt."
Gu Zheng did not pause.
The third knife follows closely!
